one_liner: World-famous racewear designer and flamboyant host of the Beauty Dream Cup; Sasami Anshinzawa's more successful younger sister.
personality: No profile text or voice lines exist for her in the mdb. Other characters' lines frame her as an eccentric, larger-than-life designer: Air Groove calls her someone with 'more than one or two quirks' and muses that her word 'Beauty' may be philosophical. Web sources describe her as upbeat and confident, treating each outfit as 'a date with destiny' with its wearer.

story_arc.summary: Not a trainee; she has no training story. She debuts in the story event 'Racing Hearts: Beauty in Bloom!' (JP May 2021), where she brings her Beauty Dream Cup to Japan and auditions 'muses' (Mayano Top Gun, Air Groove and others) to race in wedding-dress racewear she designs. She later hosts the Beauty Dream Cup again in 'The Promised Hour: Silks & Three Riddles', judging muses on intellect.
